verdict.line: You lose if you eat a clean Hookshot into Q and W before level 6; you win every trade once your W (Purge) hits 0 cooldown around level 9 and Black Cleaver comes online.

brief.thesis: Camille's entire game plan runs through landing E (Hookshot) to open her combo, and Urgot's E (Disdain) has the exact tool to punish that commitment — it shields him and hurls any champion it catches away before she lands a clean knockup. Past level 9 Urgot's W (Purge) drops to 0 cooldown and becomes a permanent trading tool that Camille has nothing to match, which is why this sits almost perfectly even at 51.3% over 974 games.

theirWindow.when: Her E (Hookshot) is up near a wall
theirWindow.what: She leaps off terrain and knocks up on landing, then chains Q (Precision Protocol) and W (Tactical Sweep) for a full combo. If you're caught without your own E or Flash up near a wall she can path to, she gets a free all-in.

yourWindow.when: She commits to the Hookshot animation
yourWindow.what: Charge your E (Disdain) into her the moment she leaps; it shields you from the hit and, because it stops and hurls any enemy champion it catches, it throws her out of position before she can land the knockup chain.

start.why: Most-picked start in this matchup (89.5% pick, 50.7% win rate over 1,052 games) — the extra sustain covers you through Camille's Q poke before you get E online.

boots.why: Highest pick rate (70.4%) of the boots options; flat damage reduction blunts her auto-attack resets and Q-empowered hits, which is where most of her early damage comes from.

core.why: Standard first core item; the armor shred cuts through the durability her passive shield and W heal are built around.

runes.keystoneWhy: Best-performing page here (55.2% win rate); it rewards the sustained auto-attack pressure from repeated Purge (W) casts and punishes her for standing in range to trade.

summoners.why: Highest win rate (51.5%) and by far the most-picked combo (82.9%) in this matchup — Ignite closes out the trades you win once you land E (Disdain) or threaten the R execute.

playing.title: Punish Hookshot with your own E
playing.detail: When she commits E (Hookshot) to close the gap, charge Disdain into her path — it shields you and hurls her away if it connects, breaking her combo before the knockup lands.

playing.title: Trade when her Q is down
playing.detail: Precision Protocol is only 9 to 5 seconds on cooldown by rank, but with no empowered attack up she has far less burst — step in with Q (Corrosive Charge) and autos the moment it's spent.

playing.title: Dodge the outer rim of her W
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep fires after a delay and only the outer half slows, deals extra damage, and heals her — stay inside the delay or disengage rather than eating the rim.

playing.title: Spam W once it's maxed
playing.detail: Following the standard EWQWWRWEWEREEQQ order, Purge hits 0 cooldown by around level 9 — from there, run it constantly to trigger Echoing Flames and keep pressure on uncontested.

playing.title: Hold E for her all-in, not to poke
playing.detail: Disdain is your only answer to Hookshot, so don't burn it chasing poke damage — keep it up after level 6 so it's ready the instant she commits.

playing.title: Threaten execute with R on overextension
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death reaches 2,500 range and a 70-second cooldown at rank 3 — any low-health dive or overextension from her should be met with R instead of a melee trade.

brief.patchCaveat: The build paths, rune pages, and all win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability readings and trade timing are my own tactical judgement.

stats.opponentTip: Use [E] to respond to Camille closing in with (E). Avoid being hit with her (W) when fighiting her.
